Header / Tagline: MATERIAL HANDLING • INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT • ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS
Enquiry Type: New Purchase
To: Sales / Estimation Department
Dear Sir/Madam,
Please submit your most competitive technical and commercial offer for the items listed below. All equipment shall be new, unused, suitable for industrial duty, and supplied with applicable test certificates, operating manuals and warranty documentation. Clearly identify any deviations.
Note: Quantities are estimated for quotation. Final quantities and configuration will be confirmed in the purchase order.

2. TECHNICAL AND QUALITY REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Duty and construction: Equipment shall be suitable for regular industrial material-handling service. State duty classification, operating cycle, and recommended service conditions.
2.2 Electrical requirements: Motors and controls shall be compatible with 415 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply. State motor rating, insulation class, ingress protection rating, and control voltage.
2.3 Safety features: Provide overload protection where applicable, upper/lower travel limits, emergency stop on pendant, and suitable braking arrangement.
2.4 Standards and testing: State applicable IS/ISO/EN standards. Provide routine test certificates, load test certificate, and inspection reports as applicable.
2.5 Documentation: Supply operation and maintenance manuals, recommended spare-parts list, wiring diagram, general arrangement drawing, and warranty certificate.
2.6 Identification: Each major item shall have a durable nameplate showing manufacturer, model, serial number, rated capacity, and manufacturing date.

3. BIDDER TO COMPLETE
Manufacturer / Brand: To be specified in quotation
Offered model / part number: To be specified in quotation
Country of origin: To be specified in quotation
Warranty period: State offered period
Lead time from PO: State in calendar weeks
Technical deviations: List each deviation; write "Nil" if none
Datasheets and drawings attached: Yes / No

4. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE
Material may be inspected at receipt for quantity, visible damage, completeness of documentation, and conformity with the purchase order. Any shortage, transit damage, or non-conformance shall be reported to the supplier for resolution. Receipt of goods does not waive the purchaser's right to raise a documented quality claim for latent defects within the applicable warranty period.

6. QUOTATION SUBMISSION CHECKLIST
Item-wise unit price and extended total for every requested line item
GST, freight, packing, insurance and other charges shown separately
Delivery commitment and quotation validity clearly stated
Brand, model, datasheets, drawings and certificates attached
All deviations and exclusions explicitly listed

7. SUBMISSION DETAILS
Email your signed quotation in PDF format to purchase@gmhi.example with the subject line Quotation – GMHI/PROC/26-184 – [Supplier Name] no later than 27 October 2026, 5:00 PM IST.
For technical clarifications, contact Rahul Mehta, Purchase Manager at +91 79 4000 2180 or purchase@gmhi.example. Any clarification affecting price or delivery should be received before the deadline.
